# Aunt Euphemia

## Appearance

Aunt Euphemia is a small, elderly woman with a diminutive, gently triangular face featuring rose-colored cheeks and big, tender blue eyes that hold an irrepressible youthfulness. Her silver-white hair is arranged in charming, small rolls above her ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is a good-humored woman who views [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) as completely insane, though she can be entirely won over by respectful manners and a lovely voice. Despite her fear of dreadful serpents, she chose to travel to [India](../codex/places.md#india) to look into her daughter's mission field.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Nell-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P25](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0025), [v3 ch.Speaks P9](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0009), [v3 ch.Rowena P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## History

Aunt Euphemia grew up in a family with around six girls and was named Jamesina after her father, who tragically drowned at sea a month prior to her birth. In her youth, she routinely mocked and rejected her suitors, once advising a former suitor to wear an elastic strip to flatten his ears. She was forbidden by both her mother and her husband from owning a yellow silk dress, and she eventually received a cat named [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) as a gift from her laundress. Prior to permitting her daughter to attend university for mathematics, Aunt Euphemia personally taught her how to cook, and she later braved a personal fear of snakes to travel to [India](../codex/places.md#india) to investigate her daughter's mission field. In her later years, she moved into Tabby's Place with her two cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), reassuring the young women living there that she would not enforce strict supervision over them. During her time at Tabby's Place, she offered guidance to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on turning twenty and character growth, and she shared lighthearted conversations about her past romances with her young housemates.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +16 more_

## Quotes

> “I do not think the Devil could be quite so unattractive,” Aunt Euphemia remarked thoughtfully. “He would fail to cause as much damage were that the case. My impression of him has always been that of an attractive gentleman.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Relationships P71](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0071)

> "Well, Nell, I do hope that is true, since I am in love with her. However, I fail to comprehend her—she completely baffles me. She differs from every girl I have ever known, as well as every girl that I used to be."
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Indeed, within my spirit. However, I must concede that my legs lack the youth of your own. Head outside to catch some fresh air, Nell. Your complexion has appeared pale recently."
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

> “Go out and breathe some fresh air,” Aunt Euphemia reiterated, “yet carry your umbrella with you, because I think rain is coming. My leg has rheumatism.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P8](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0008)

> “Oh, men—yes. However, it was of ministers that I was speaking, my dear,” Aunt Euphemia said in a rebuking manner. “Furthermore, you ought not to flirt in that way with Mr. Hale—you truly ought not to.”
>
> — Aunt Euphemia — [v3 ch.Charming P15](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0015)

## Relationships

### [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--cressy-lindsay.md)

Aunt Euphemia lives with [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) at Tabby's Place, where she reassures the young women that she will not strictly supervise their household. They share warm domestic moments, such as discussing Cressy's ball gown, her various suitors, and her potential for marriage before she heads off to dances. Aunt Euphemia also candidly chats about Cressy's unique personality behind her back.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), +8 more_
